words.enDefinition: a store page describing a particular app

examples.en: I opened the app listing to check what the study timer could do.
examples.zh: 我打开「应用商店详情页」，看看这个学习计时器有哪些功能。

examples.en: The app listing included the developer's name beneath the first picture.
examples.zh: 「应用商店详情页」的第一张图下面写了开发者的名称。

words.enDefinition: an app marketplace operated or endorsed by a platform provider

examples.en: Our course guide named the official app store for our reading app.
examples.zh: 课程指南注明了阅读应用所在的「官方应用商店」。

examples.en: I found the campus timetable app in the official app store on my phone.
examples.zh: 我在手机的「官方应用商店」找到了校园课表应用。

collocations: find an app in the official app store

words.enDefinition: the person or organisation responsible for releasing an app

examples.en: I checked who the app publisher was before asking about a student edition.
examples.zh: 咨询学生版之前，我先确认了谁是「应用发行方」。

examples.en: The app publisher was listed beside the developer's support address.
examples.zh: 「应用发行方」列在开发者的支持联系地址旁边。

words.enDefinition: images on a listing showing how parts of an app look

examples.en: The app screenshots showed where I could see my weekly timetable.
examples.zh: 「应用截图」显示了在哪里可以查看我的每周课表。

examples.en: I looked through the app screenshots before choosing the language practice tool.
examples.zh: 选语言练习工具前，我先浏览了「应用截图」。

words.enDefinition: a short listing video showing an app in use

examples.en: The app preview video showed how a student organised her reading notes.
examples.zh: 「应用预览视频」演示了一名学生怎样整理阅读笔记。

examples.en: I watched the app preview video before opening the full description.
examples.zh: 打开完整说明前，我看了「应用预览视频」。

collocations: an app preview video on the listing

words.enDefinition: the written details explaining what an app does

examples.en: I read the app description to see whether it supported handwritten notes.
examples.zh: 我看了「应用说明」，想确认它是不是支持手写笔记。

examples.en: The app description mentioned a feature for saving a reading list.
examples.zh: 「应用说明」提到了保存阅读书单的功能。

words.enDefinition: a section of an app store for apps with similar uses

examples.en: I chose the store category for education before looking at the apps.
examples.zh: 查看应用之前，我选了教育这一「商店分类」。

examples.en: The store category helped me find more tools for planning study sessions.
examples.zh: 这个「商店分类」帮我找到了更多安排学习时间的工具。

words.enDefinition: software for organising tasks, time or work

examples.en: I compared a few productivity apps before choosing one for my coursework.
examples.zh: 为了选一个做课程作业用的工具，我比较了几款「效率类应用」。

examples.en: The store displayed productivity apps next to tools for learning languages.
examples.zh: 商店把「效率类应用」显示在语言学习工具旁边。

words.enDefinition: an app given prominent placement by a store

examples.en: I noticed a featured app for planning reading sessions on the front page.
examples.zh: 我在首页看到一款安排阅读时间的「精选应用」。

examples.en: The featured app changed after the end of the study week.
examples.zh: 学习周结束后，展示的「精选应用」换了。

collocations: a featured app on the front page

words.enDefinition: a label for an app recommended by a store's editorial team

examples.en: The planner had an “Editor's choice” label beside its description.
examples.zh: 这款计划工具的说明旁有个「编辑精选」标识。

examples.en: I recognised the “Editor's choice” badge on the language learning app.
examples.zh: 我认出了语言学习应用上的「编辑精选」徽标。

words.enDefinition: labels explaining which kinds of content a product may contain

examples.en: I read the content descriptors beside the app's age rating.
examples.zh: 我看了应用年龄分级旁的「内容分级说明」。

examples.en: The content descriptors were listed under the game information in the store.
examples.zh: 商店把「内容分级说明」列在游戏信息的下方。

collocations: content descriptors next to a rating

words.enDefinition: a group of apps offered together as a package

examples.en: The app bundle included a planner and a separate timer for study sessions.
examples.zh: 这个「应用套装」包含一个计划工具和独立的学习计时器。

examples.en: I checked which tools came in the app bundle before choosing it.
examples.zh: 选这个「应用套装」之前，我先查了里面有哪些工具。

collocations: include an app in a bundle

words.enDefinition: available to get without paying a download price

examples.en: The vocabulary app was free to download when I found it in the store.
examples.zh: 我在商店里找到那款词汇应用时，它「可免费下载」。

examples.en: I checked whether the app was free to download on both devices.
examples.zh: 我查了应用在两台设备上是否都「可免费下载」。

collocations: make an app free to download
an app that is free to download

words.enDefinition: an app that costs money to obtain from a store

examples.en: I chose a paid app after comparing the tools listed for both options.
examples.zh: 对比两个选项列出的工具后，我选了一个「付费应用」。

examples.en: The paid app had the price next to its download button.
examples.zh: 「付费应用」的价格显示在下载按钮旁。

words.enDefinition: an item or feature sold from within an app

examples.en: The extra drawing templates were offered as an in-app purchase.
examples.zh: 额外的绘画模板被列为「应用内购买项目」。

examples.en: I checked what the in-app purchase would add to my reading app.
examples.zh: 我确认了这个「应用内购买项目」会给阅读应用增加什么。

words.enDefinition: an area inside an app offering items or extra features

examples.en: I opened the in-app store to see the extra drawing brushes.
examples.zh: 我打开「应用内商店」，看看有哪些额外的绘画笔刷。

examples.en: The in-app store grouped the extra templates by theme and subject.
examples.zh: 「应用内商店」按主题和题材给额外模板分了类。

collocations: an item in the in-app store

words.enDefinition: the amount of data transferred to download an app

examples.en: I checked the download size while browsing the app's listing.
examples.zh: 我浏览应用详情页时，查了「下载文件大小」。

examples.en: The store showed the download size beneath the supported language list.
examples.zh: 商店在支持语言列表下方显示了「下载文件大小」。

words.enDefinition: the amount of storage an app takes up once installed

examples.en: The installed size was larger than the number shown before downloading.
examples.zh: 「安装后占用空间」比下载前显示的数字大。

examples.en: I compared the installed size of the two note apps on my tablet.
examples.zh: 我对比了平板上两款笔记应用的「安装后占用空间」。

words.enDefinition: the least hardware and software needed to use an app

examples.en: I read the minimum system requirements before downloading the drawing software.
examples.zh: 下载绘画软件之前，我看了「最低系统要求」。

examples.en: The minimum system requirements were listed below the screenshots for the app.
examples.zh: 「最低系统要求」列在应用截图下方。

words.enDefinition: the devices on which a particular app is intended to work

examples.en: I checked supported devices to see whether my old tablet appeared.
examples.zh: 我查看了「兼容设备」，想知道有没有我的旧平板。

examples.en: The store displayed supported devices on the same page as system requirements.
examples.zh: 商店把「兼容设备」和系统要求放在同一个页面。

words.enDefinition: a message saying an app cannot be used on the current device

examples.en: The listing said “Not compatible with this device” when I opened it.
examples.zh: 我打开详情页时，看到了「与此设备不兼容」。

examples.en: I saw “Not compatible with this device” beside the older tablet's name.
examples.zh: 我在旧平板的名称旁看到了「与此设备不兼容」。

collocations: see a “Not compatible with this device” message

words.enDefinition: information about where an app or feature is offered

examples.en: I checked the regional availability of the app before our exchange term.
examples.zh: 交换学期前，我查了这款应用「在各地区的提供情况」。

examples.en: The store listed regional availability separately from the languages the app included.
examples.zh: 商店把「各地区的提供情况」和应用支持的语言分开列出。

words.enDefinition: the country or area assigned to a store account and its catalogue

examples.en: I checked the store region shown beside the app name on my account.
examples.zh: 我查看了账号里应用名称旁显示的「应用商店地区」。

examples.en: The help page explained where to find the current store region.
examples.zh: 帮助页面说明了在哪里查看当前的「应用商店地区」。

collocations: a catalogue for a store region

words.enDefinition: permission granted to use an app under specified terms

examples.en: I checked whether the app licence included use on my desktop.
examples.zh: 我查看了「应用使用许可」是否涵盖在台式机上使用。

examples.en: The course provided an app licence for students in the design workshop.
examples.zh: 课程为设计工作坊里的学生提供了「应用使用许可」。

words.enDefinition: the process of making authorised software features available for use

examples.en: The setup screen described product activation before the drawing software opened.
examples.zh: 绘画软件打开前，设置页面说明了「产品激活」。

examples.en: I saw a product activation message after opening my licensed study app.
examples.zh: 我打开有使用许可的学习应用后，看到了「产品激活」消息。

words.enDefinition: an extra feature that users may choose to add

examples.en: The extra handwriting tools were listed as an optional add-on for the app.
examples.zh: 额外的手写工具列为这款应用的「可选附加功能」。

examples.en: I checked what the optional add-on would change in my planner.
examples.zh: 我确认了这个「可选附加功能」会给计划工具带来什么变化。

words.enDefinition: the website run by the people or organisation that built an app

examples.en: I found a short guide on the developer website before installing the app.
examples.zh: 安装应用前，我在「开发者网站」找到了简短的指南。

examples.en: The developer website listed the new drawing tools and explained their names.
examples.zh: 「开发者网站」列出了新的绘画工具，并解释了名称。

words.enDefinition: a store link for finding help with a specific app

examples.en: The app support link opened a page about the classroom edition.
examples.zh: 「应用支持链接」打开了一个介绍课堂版的页面。

examples.en: I used the app support link to look up the programme's controls.
examples.zh: 我通过「应用支持链接」查看这个程序的操作方式。

collocations: an app support link on a listing

words.enDefinition: information about how an app handles or uses data

examples.en: I read the app privacy details before trying the study programme.
examples.zh: 试用这款学习软件前，我看了「应用隐私详情」。

examples.en: The app privacy details appeared near the bottom of the listing.
examples.zh: 「应用隐私详情」出现在商店详情页靠近底部的位置。

collocations: app privacy details on a listing

words.enDefinition: the languages in which an app can display content or controls

examples.en: I checked supported languages to see whether the menu could appear in Spanish.
examples.zh: 我查看「支持的语言」，想知道菜单能不能用西班牙语显示。

examples.en: The app listed supported languages beside the platform information on its store page.
examples.zh: 应用的商店页面把「支持的语言」列在平台信息旁边。

words.enDefinition: the control for starting an app download in some stores

examples.en: I tapped the Get button beside the class timetable app.
examples.zh: 我点了课程表应用旁边的「获取按钮」。

examples.en: The Get button appeared below the name of the drawing app.
examples.zh: 「获取按钮」显示在绘画应用名称的下方。

words.enDefinition: to add an app to a device so it can be opened

examples.en: Our tutor showed where to install an app from the class link.
examples.zh: 导师告诉我们，可以在哪里通过班级链接「安装一款应用」。

examples.en: I wanted to install an app for editing my sketches between classes.
examples.zh: 我想「安装一款应用」，好在课间编辑自己的速写。

collocations: install an app on a tablet
a guide to install an app

words.enDefinition: a list of the apps already present on a device

examples.en: I checked the installed app list before borrowing the classroom tablet.
examples.zh: 借用课堂平板之前，我看了「已安装应用列表」。

examples.en: The new drawing tool appeared in the installed app list that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午，新的绘画工具出现在「已安装应用列表」里。

collocations: an app on the installed app list

words.enDefinition: to look for newer versions of the apps on a device

examples.en: I wanted to check for app updates before our next study session.
examples.zh: 下次自习前，我想「检查应用更新」。

examples.en: The store menu showed how to check for app updates on my tablet.
examples.zh: 商店菜单介绍了怎样在我的平板上「检查应用更新」。

collocations: remember to check for app updates
let users check for app updates

words.enDefinition: a message saying that a newer version can be installed

examples.en: I saw “Update available” beside the note-taking app that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早晨，我在笔记应用旁看到了「有可用更新」。

examples.en: The store displayed “Update available” above the description of the new drawing tools.
examples.zh: 商店在新绘画工具的说明上方显示了「有可用更新」。

words.enDefinition: a status showing that selected updates are waiting to be installed

examples.en: The tablet still showed “Updates pending” when I checked it after class.
examples.zh: 我下课后查看平板时，还是显示「更新待安装」。

examples.en: I noticed “Updates pending” at the top of the app list.
examples.zh: 我在应用列表顶部看到了「更新待安装」。

words.enDefinition: an option to install each available app update together

examples.en: I chose “Update all” after checking which study apps had new versions.
examples.zh: 查完哪些学习应用出了新版本后，我选了「全部更新」。

examples.en: The store displayed an “Update all” button above the available updates.
examples.zh: 商店在可用更新的上方显示了「全部更新」按钮。

words.enDefinition: a setting that installs newer app versions without prompting each time

examples.en: I checked whether automatic app updates were enabled on the shared tablet.
examples.zh: 我查了那台共用平板上有没有开「应用自动更新」。

examples.en: Automatic app updates kept the campus reading app current during the break.
examples.zh: 假期里，「应用自动更新」让校园阅读应用保持在较新版本。

words.enDefinition: a record of app updates previously installed on a device

examples.en: I checked the app update history to see when my planner had changed.
examples.zh: 我查看了「应用更新记录」，想知道计划工具是什么时候更新的。

examples.en: The app update history listed the new version beside the installation date.
examples.zh: 「应用更新记录」把新版本和安装日期列在一起。

collocations: a date in the app update history

words.enDefinition: an update an app requires before allowing normal use

examples.en: The timetable app displayed a mandatory update before opening the new term's schedule.
examples.zh: 课表应用在打开新学期课表前提示有一项「必须安装的更新」。

examples.en: I saw a message about a mandatory update on the store page.
examples.zh: 我在商店页面上看到一则关于「必须安装的更新」的消息。

collocations: a notice about a mandatory update

words.enDefinition: an update you can choose to install now or leave for later

examples.en: The store showed an optional update for the reading app after class.
examples.zh: 下课后，商店显示阅读应用有一项「可选更新」。

examples.en: I read the notes about the optional update while waiting for my seminar.
examples.zh: 等研讨课开始时，我看了「可选更新」的说明。

collocations: wait to install an optional update

words.enDefinition: a written summary of the changes in a software release

examples.en: I read the release notes to see where the drawing tools had moved.
examples.zh: 我看了「版本更新说明」，想知道绘画工具移到了哪里。

examples.en: The release notes listed the new templates for the study planner.
examples.zh: 「版本更新说明」列出了学习计划工具新增的模板。

collocations: changes listed in the release notes

words.enDefinition: the label identifying a particular release of an app

examples.en: I checked the version number before comparing screens with my roommate.
examples.zh: 和室友对比画面之前，我先查了「版本号」。

examples.en: The version number appeared at the bottom of the app information page.
examples.zh: 「版本号」显示在应用信息页的底部。

words.enDefinition: a label identifying a particular packaged build of a software release

examples.en: The app information page listed a build number beneath the version label.
examples.zh: 应用信息页在版本标签下面列了一个「构建编号」。

examples.en: I wrote down the build number while comparing the two classroom tablets.
examples.zh: 对比两台课堂平板时，我记下了「构建编号」。

collocations: a build number in app information

words.enDefinition: the most recent release available for a piece of software

examples.en: I checked whether the latest version included the reading list we needed.
examples.zh: 我查了「最新版本」里有没有我们需要的阅读书单功能。

examples.en: The class guide showed screenshots from the latest version of the app.
examples.zh: 班级指南里放的是这款应用「最新版本」的截图。

words.enDefinition: an update bringing substantial changes to software

examples.en: A major update moved the planner's calendar to a separate screen.
examples.zh: 一次「重大更新」把计划工具的日历移到了单独的页面。

examples.en: The developer described the new drawing workspace as a major update.
examples.zh: 开发者把新的绘画工作区称为一次「重大更新」。

words.enDefinition: an update making relatively small changes to software

examples.en: The minor update changed how section labels appeared in the menu.
examples.zh: 这次「小幅更新」改变了区块名称在菜单里的显示方式。

examples.en: I read about a minor update to the app's reading tools.
examples.zh: 我看了阅读工具的一次「小幅更新」的说明。

words.enDefinition: a release focused on correcting problems in earlier software

examples.en: The notes called it a bug fix release for the drawing app.
examples.zh: 说明把它称为绘画应用的一个「缺陷修复版本」。

examples.en: I checked whether the bug fix release changed any of our classroom tools.
examples.zh: 我确认了「缺陷修复版本」有没有改动课堂上用的工具。

collocations: check for a bug fix release
notes for a bug fix release

words.enDefinition: a status indicating a download is waiting to begin

examples.en: The tablet showed “Download queued” beside the new language practice app.
examples.zh: 平板在新语言练习应用旁显示「下载已排队」。

examples.en: I saw “Download queued” while the first study tool was still downloading.
examples.zh: 第一款学习工具还在下载时，我看到了「下载已排队」。

words.enDefinition: a status showing an app is currently being installed

examples.en: The screen said “Installation in progress” when I checked my tablet.
examples.zh: 我查看平板时，屏幕上写着「正在安装」。

examples.en: I waited after “Installation in progress” appeared next to the app name.
examples.zh: 应用名称旁出现「正在安装」后，我等了一会儿。

words.enDefinition: a message indicating that a newer version has finished installing

examples.en: I saw “Update complete” before opening the planner again after class.
examples.zh: 下课后，我先看到「更新完成」，才重新打开计划工具。

examples.en: The store showed “Update complete” below the drawing app's name.
examples.zh: 商店在绘画应用的名称下方显示了「更新完成」。

words.enDefinition: the oldest operating system release supported by an app

examples.en: The listing gave the minimum OS version below the supported device models.
examples.zh: 详情页在支持的设备型号下方列出了「最低操作系统版本」。

examples.en: I checked the minimum OS version for the classroom tablet before downloading.
examples.zh: 下载前，我核对了课堂平板上的「最低操作系统版本」要求。

words.enDefinition: the amount of room an app needs for installation

examples.en: I checked the required storage space before choosing the drawing software.
examples.zh: 选择绘画软件前，我查了「所需存储空间」。

examples.en: The required storage space was listed below the operating system version.
examples.zh: 「所需存储空间」列在操作系统版本下方。

words.enDefinition: to add software you use to a second device

examples.en: I checked whether my licence let me install on another device.
examples.zh: 我查了自己的许可允许不允许「安装到另一台设备上」。

examples.en: The store showed which apps I could install on another device.
examples.zh: 商店列出了哪些应用我可以「安装到另一台设备上」。

collocations: be allowed to install on another device
decide to install on another device
check whether you can install on another device

words.enDefinition: to download again an app you obtained in an earlier purchase

examples.en: I used the store to re-download a purchased app for my new tablet.
examples.zh: 我通过商店给新平板「重新下载已购应用」。

examples.en: I checked how to re-download a purchased app from the account menu.
examples.zh: 我查了怎样从账号菜单「重新下载已购应用」。

collocations: choose to re-download a purchased app
be able to re-download a purchased app
re-download a purchased app on a new device

words.enDefinition: a message asking for a restart so an update can finish

examples.en: The laptop displayed “Restart to finish update” after I closed the app.
examples.zh: 关闭应用后，笔记本电脑显示「重启以完成更新」。

examples.en: I noticed “Restart to finish update” below the list of installed changes.
examples.zh: 我在已安装的变更列表下方看到了「重启以完成更新」。

collocations: a message saying “Restart to finish update”
prompt users to “Restart to finish update”

words.enDefinition: an option to postpone installation of a newer version

examples.en: I tapped “Update later” because I was about to open my timetable.
examples.zh: 我正要打开课表，就点了「稍后更新」。

examples.en: The store offered “Update later” next to the immediate install option.
examples.zh: 商店在立即安装选项旁提供了「稍后更新」。

words.enDefinition: a version of software accessed through a web browser

examples.en: We used the web version when working on the library's shared computers.
examples.zh: 我们用图书馆的共用电脑时，选了「网页版」。

examples.en: The web version let me open the reading tool from my browser.
examples.zh: 「网页版」让我能直接从浏览器打开阅读工具。

collocations: a link to the web version

words.enDefinition: a version of software designed for laptop or desktop computers

examples.en: I chose the desktop version so I could work on a larger screen.
examples.zh: 我选了「桌面版」，好在更大的屏幕上操作。

examples.en: The desktop version had a menu bar above the drawing tools.
examples.zh: 「桌面版」在绘画工具上方有一栏菜单。

words.enDefinition: a version of software designed for phones or tablets

examples.en: I opened the mobile version to see how the timetable fit.
examples.zh: 我打开「移动端版本」，看看课表在小屏幕上怎么显示。

examples.en: The mobile version used shorter labels for the same drawing tools.
examples.zh: 同样的绘画工具，在「移动端版本」里用的标签更短。

collocations: a feature in the mobile version

words.enDefinition: a version made available for testing before the final release

examples.en: The developer invited students to try a beta version of the planner.
examples.zh: 开发者邀请学生试用计划工具的「测试版」。

examples.en: I read the feedback about the beta version before the classroom demonstration.
examples.zh: 课堂演示前，我看了关于「测试版」的反馈。

words.enDefinition: a release intended for normal use after testing

examples.en: The class guide recommended the stable release for the drawing assignment.
examples.zh: 课程指南建议用「稳定版」完成绘画作业。

examples.en: I waited for a stable release before putting the app on my tablet.
examples.zh: 我等出了「稳定版」，才把这款应用装到平板上。

words.enDefinition: the controls for changing how the device itself behaves

examples.en: I opened system settings to check which language the tablet used.
examples.zh: 我打开「系统设置」，查看平板用的是哪种语言。

examples.en: The system settings showed where to choose the default reading app.
examples.zh: 「系统设置」显示了在哪里选默认阅读应用。

words.enDefinition: the controls for changing the behaviour of one app

examples.en: I found the calendar format under app settings after the update.
examples.zh: 更新后，我在「应用设置」里找到了日历格式。

examples.en: The app settings let me choose between two layouts for my notes.
examples.zh: 在「应用设置」里，我可以为笔记选两种排版中的一种。

words.enDefinition: a search tool for locating controls in the settings interface

examples.en: I used settings search to find the language option on the tablet.
examples.zh: 我用「设置搜索」找到了平板上的语言选项。

examples.en: The settings search found two places to change how dates appeared.
examples.zh: 「设置搜索」找到了两个可以改日期显示方式的位置。

collocations: type a term into settings search

words.enDefinition: a smaller menu opened from an item in a larger menu

examples.en: I found the language option in a submenu under the main settings.
examples.zh: 我在主设置下的一个「子菜单」里找到了语言选项。

examples.en: The submenu stayed open while I read through the different options.
examples.zh: 我逐项看说明时，「子菜单」一直开着。

collocations: choose an option from a submenu

words.enDefinition: a single command or choice in a menu

examples.en: I selected the menu item that opened information about the app.
examples.zh: 我选了打开应用信息的那个「菜单项」。

examples.en: The menu item appeared only when the drawing tool was open.
examples.zh: 只有绘画工具打开时，这个「菜单项」才会出现。

words.enDefinition: a strip containing menus arranged next to one another

examples.en: The menu bar was above the drawing space on my laptop.
examples.zh: 笔记本电脑上，「菜单栏」在绘画区上方。

examples.en: I opened the settings menu from the menu bar after class.
examples.zh: 下课后，我从「菜单栏」打开了设置菜单。

collocations: an item in the menu bar

words.enDefinition: a menu of actions relevant to the current item or area

examples.en: The context menu offered choices for opening the picture in different apps.
examples.zh: 「上下文菜单」给出了用不同应用打开图片的选项。

examples.en: I opened the context menu for the notes file on my laptop.
examples.zh: 我打开了笔记本电脑上那个笔记文件的「上下文菜单」。

collocations: an option on the context menu

words.enDefinition: a menu holding actions that are not shown on the main toolbar

examples.en: I found the language choice in the overflow menu on the small screen.
examples.zh: 我在小屏幕的「更多选项菜单」里找到了语言选择。

examples.en: The overflow menu held a link to the app's version information.
examples.zh: 「更多选项菜单」里有个通往应用版本信息的链接。

collocations: an action in the overflow menu

words.enDefinition: a picture of a gear commonly used for opening settings

examples.en: I tapped the gear icon to look for the app's language options.
examples.zh: 我点了「齿轮图标」，想找应用的语言选项。

examples.en: The gear icon was beside the title on the reading app's home page.
examples.zh: 「齿轮图标」在阅读应用首页的标题旁边。

words.enDefinition: a control that changes a setting between two states

examples.en: I used the toggle switch to show week numbers in my planner.
examples.zh: 我用「切换开关」开启了计划工具里的周数显示。

examples.en: A toggle switch beside the option showed whether it was enabled.
examples.zh: 选项旁的「切换开关」显示它是否已开启。

collocations: a toggle switch for a setting

words.enDefinition: the app automatically chosen for a particular action or file type

examples.en: I made my usual reader the default app for lecture notes.
examples.zh: 我把常用的阅读器设成了打开讲义的「默认应用」。

examples.en: The tablet asked which programme should become the default app for pictures.
examples.zh: 平板问用哪个程序作图片的「默认应用」。

collocations: the default app for a file type

words.enDefinition: to make a choice the one used automatically in the future

examples.en: I selected “Set as default” after choosing my usual PDF reader.
examples.zh: 选好常用 PDF 阅读器后，我点了「设为默认」。

examples.en: The app showed “Set as default” beside the other language options.
examples.zh: 应用在其他语言选项旁显示了「设为默认」。

collocations: choose an app to set as default

words.enDefinition: a menu choice for selecting which app will open a file

examples.en: I used “Open with” to try the new programme on a picture.
examples.zh: 我用「打开方式」试着用新程序打开一张图片。

examples.en: The menu showed “Open with” beneath the picture's file information.
examples.zh: 菜单在图片的文件信息下方显示了「打开方式」。

words.enDefinition: the language chosen for one app's menus and messages

examples.en: I changed the app language while helping my roommate with the setup.
examples.zh: 我帮室友设置时更改了「应用语言」。

examples.en: The app language stayed English when I changed the calendar format.
examples.zh: 改完日历格式后，「应用语言」仍然是英语。

words.enDefinition: the language used by the device's operating system

examples.en: The system language determined which labels appeared in the tablet's menus.
examples.zh: 「系统语言」决定了平板菜单上的标签用什么语言显示。

examples.en: I checked the system language before comparing menu labels with my roommate.
examples.zh: 我先查了「系统语言」，再和室友对照菜单标签。

words.enDefinition: a setting making an app follow the device's language choice

examples.en: I chose “Use device language” after checking the reader's own options.
examples.zh: 看过阅读器自己的选项后，我选了「使用设备语言」。

examples.en: The app listed “Use device language” above the other available languages.
examples.zh: 应用在其他可用语言的上方列了「使用设备语言」。

words.enDefinition: a collection of translated interface material for software

examples.en: I saw a language pack listed in the downloads for the classroom app.
examples.zh: 我在课堂应用的下载列表里看到一个「语言包」。

examples.en: The teacher checked whether a language pack existed for the drawing programme.
examples.zh: 老师查了绘画软件有没有「语言包」。

words.enDefinition: the units an app uses to display quantities such as distance

examples.en: I checked the units of measurement before comparing the two map readings.
examples.zh: 比较两个地图读数之前，我查了「度量单位」。

examples.en: The app let me switch units of measurement in the settings screen.
examples.zh: 应用让我能在设置页面切换「度量单位」。

words.enDefinition: the arrangement of day, month and year in a written date

examples.en: I changed the date format in my planner after the term started.
examples.zh: 学期开始后，我改了计划工具里的「日期显示格式」。

examples.en: The date format made the labels on my calendar easier to understand.
examples.zh: 这一「日期显示格式」让日历上的标签更容易看懂。

words.enDefinition: a choice to follow the system's values for supported preferences

examples.en: I chose “Use device settings” to match the tablet's date display.
examples.zh: 我选了「使用设备设置」，让日期显示和平板一致。

examples.en: The preferences screen displayed “Use device settings” beneath the units menu.
examples.zh: 偏好设置页面在单位菜单下方显示了「使用设备设置」。

words.enDefinition: a setting letting an app start when you enter your device account

examples.en: I turned on “Open at login” for the planner I used every morning.
examples.zh: 我给每天早上用的计划工具开启了「登录系统时自动打开」。

examples.en: The menu offered “Open at login” near the other launch options.
examples.zh: 菜单把「登录系统时自动打开」放在其他启动选项旁。

words.enDefinition: a setting that keeps an app's control visible in the menu bar

examples.en: I selected “Show in menu bar” to keep the timer visible.
examples.zh: 为了让计时器一直可见，我选了「在菜单栏中显示」。

examples.en: The app placed “Show in menu bar” with its other display settings.
examples.zh: 应用把「在菜单栏中显示」和其他显示设置放在了一起。

words.enDefinition: to keep chosen settings for later use

examples.en: I used “Save preferences” after changing the planner's date display.
examples.zh: 改好计划工具里的日期显示后，我用了「保存偏好设置」。

examples.en: The window showed “Save preferences” at the bottom of the page.
examples.zh: 窗口页面底部显示了「保存偏好设置」。

words.enDefinition: to make the new settings take effect

examples.en: I clicked “Apply changes” to see the new layout on the screen.
examples.zh: 我点了「应用更改」，想看屏幕上的新排版。

examples.en: The preview stayed open until I chose “Apply changes” on the settings page.
examples.zh: 预览一直开着，直到我在设置页面选了「应用更改」。

words.enDefinition: to return selected settings to their original values

examples.en: I chose “Restore defaults” for the display options on my planner.
examples.zh: 我给计划工具的显示选项用了「恢复默认设置」。

examples.en: The help page described “Restore defaults” on the language settings screen.
examples.zh: 帮助页面介绍了语言设置页面上的「恢复默认设置」。

words.enDefinition: the controls for information and options associated with an account

examples.en: I opened account settings to see which plan was active.
examples.zh: 我打开「账户设置」，看看当前用的是哪个套餐。

examples.en: The app displayed my plan name near the bottom of account settings.
examples.zh: 应用在「账户设置」靠底部的位置显示了我的套餐名称。

words.enDefinition: a control for choosing between accounts you already use

examples.en: I used the account switcher to open my university profile before class.
examples.zh: 上课前，我用「账户切换器」打开了学校账户。

examples.en: The account switcher showed which profile was selected on my laptop.
examples.zh: 「账户切换器」在我的笔记本电脑上显示了当前选中的账户。

words.enDefinition: an account administered by an organisation such as a school

examples.en: Our department supplied a managed account for the shared drawing programme.
examples.zh: 系里为共用的绘画软件提供了一个「机构管理的账户」。

examples.en: The managed account showed the name of the university beside my details.
examples.zh: 「机构管理的账户」在我的资料旁显示了大学名称。

words.enDefinition: enabled automatically before anyone changes the setting

examples.en: The week numbers were on by default when I opened the planner.
examples.zh: 我打开计划工具时，周数显示「默认开启」。

examples.en: I checked which display options were on by default on the shared tablet.
examples.zh: 我查了共用平板上哪些显示选项「默认开启」。

collocations: a feature that is on by default

words.enDefinition: disabled automatically before anyone changes the setting

examples.en: The menu bar control was off by default on my new laptop.
examples.zh: 我的新笔记本上，菜单栏控件「默认关闭」。

examples.en: I learned that the larger calendar preview was off by default.
examples.zh: 我了解到，较大的日历预览「默认关闭」。

collocations: a setting that is off by default

words.enDefinition: a section containing options applying to the app or device overall

examples.en: I found the calendar display under general settings in the app.
examples.zh: 我在应用的「通用设置」里找到了日历显示选项。

examples.en: General settings included a choice for the first day of the week.
examples.zh: 「通用设置」里有个选择一周从哪天开始的选项。

words.enDefinition: groups that organise related options in a settings interface

examples.en: I browsed the settings categories to find the app's display section.
examples.zh: 我浏览了「设置分类」，想找到应用的显示版块。

examples.en: The settings categories were listed on the left on my computer.
examples.zh: 在我的电脑上，「设置分类」列在左边。

collocations: open one of the settings categories

words.enDefinition: to view or change the subscriptions linked to an account

examples.en: I selected “Manage subscriptions” to check the plans on my account.
examples.zh: 我选了「管理订阅」，查看自己账号名下的套餐。

examples.en: The store put “Manage subscriptions” below the account information screen.
examples.zh: 商店把「管理订阅」放在账户信息页面下方。

words.enDefinition: the current state of a subscription shown in an account

examples.en: I checked the subscription status before opening the paid version of the app.
examples.zh: 打开应用的付费版前，我查看了「订阅状态」。

examples.en: The subscription status appeared underneath the name of my reading plan.
examples.zh: 「订阅状态」显示在阅读套餐名称的下方。

words.enDefinition: a subscription that currently gives access to its services

examples.en: The account page showed an active subscription for the drawing programme.
examples.zh: 账户页面显示这个绘画软件有一项「有效订阅」。

examples.en: I checked whether my active subscription was for the reading or drawing app.
examples.zh: 我确认了这项「有效订阅」对应的是阅读应用还是绘画应用。

words.enDefinition: a status indicating that the subscribed period has ended

examples.en: The app showed “Subscription expired” after my last day of access.
examples.zh: 最后一天的使用权限结束后，应用显示「订阅已到期」。

examples.en: I saw “Subscription expired” beside the name of the extra tools.
examples.zh: 我在额外工具名称旁看到了「订阅已到期」。

words.enDefinition: a service option covering a year at a time

examples.en: I checked what the annual plan included before choosing the software.
examples.zh: 选软件之前，我查看了「年度套餐」包含哪些功能。

examples.en: The app showed the annual plan beneath the shorter plan options.
examples.zh: 应用把「年度套餐」列在期限较短的套餐选项下方。

collocations: the annual plan for an app

words.enDefinition: to check the differences between available service options

examples.en: I used “Compare plans” to see which options included extra templates.
examples.zh: 我用了「对比套餐」，看看哪些选项包含额外模板。

examples.en: The page let me compare plans before choosing the drawing tools.
examples.zh: 选绘画工具前，我可以在页面上「对比套餐」。

words.enDefinition: functions provided as part of a particular option

examples.en: I read the included features before choosing the app for our group.
examples.zh: 给小组选应用之前，我看了「套餐包含的功能」。

examples.en: The included features were listed beside each plan's name on the page.
examples.zh: 页面在各个套餐名称旁列了「套餐包含的功能」。

words.enDefinition: a restriction on how much of something a plan allows

examples.en: I checked the plan limit before adding another workspace for my course.
examples.zh: 给课程再建一个工作区之前，我查了「套餐使用上限」。

examples.en: The guide listed the plan limit below the included features.
examples.zh: 指南把「套餐使用上限」列在套餐包含的功能下方。

words.enDefinition: a level of service available without a subscription fee

examples.en: I used the free tier for the planner during my first term.
examples.zh: 第一学期，我用的是计划工具的「免费档位」。

examples.en: The free tier included the tools I needed for my reading notes.
examples.zh: 「免费档位」包含做阅读笔记需要的工具。

words.enDefinition: a paid service option offering features beyond a basic level

examples.en: I tried the premium plan because it included extra handwriting tools.
examples.zh: 我试了「高级套餐」，因为里面有额外的手写工具。

examples.en: The premium plan included more drawing templates than my current option.
examples.zh: 「高级套餐」包含的绘画模板比我现在的选项多。

words.enDefinition: permission to use software under terms intended for students

examples.en: I got a student licence for the software used in our workshop.
examples.zh: 我拿到了工作坊所用软件的「学生使用许可」。

examples.en: The student licence included the tools needed for my drawing assignment.
examples.zh: 「学生使用许可」涵盖了做绘画作业需要的工具。

words.enDefinition: wording introducing the date when a trial period finishes

examples.en: The page said “Trial ends on” above the date listed for my account.
examples.zh: 页面在我账号所列的日期上方写着「试用到期日」。

examples.en: I read “Trial ends on” before noting the date in my planner.
examples.zh: 我看到「试用到期日」后，把日期记在了计划本里。

words.enDefinition: the date when a particular subscription begins

examples.en: I checked the subscription start date before opening the new reading tools.
examples.zh: 使用新的阅读工具前，我查了「订阅开始日期」。

examples.en: The account listed my subscription start date beneath the name of the plan.
examples.zh: 账户在套餐名称下方列了我的「订阅开始日期」。

words.enDefinition: wording introducing the final date or time that access continues

examples.en: The app displayed “Access until” above the expiry date in my settings.
examples.zh: 应用在设置里的到期日期上方显示了「可使用至」。

examples.en: I checked “Access until” before planning my last session with the app.
examples.zh: 安排最后一次用这个应用前，我查看了「可使用至」。

words.enDefinition: a subscription set to continue automatically at the end of each period

examples.en: I noticed the note about an auto-renewing subscription before choosing the plan.
examples.zh: 选套餐前，我注意到了关于「自动续订套餐」的说明。

examples.en: The account listed one auto-renewing subscription among my active software plans.
examples.zh: 账户里列了我一项当前有效的「自动续订套餐」。

collocations: a label for an auto-renewing subscription

words.enDefinition: a status saying that an active plan will not continue automatically

examples.en: The account showed “Will not renew” under the name of my reading plan.
examples.zh: 账户在阅读套餐名称下方显示「将不再续订」。

examples.en: I checked the date beside “Will not renew” before closing the app.
examples.zh: 关闭应用之前，我核对了「将不再续订」旁的日期。

words.enDefinition: having subscription charges handled by the app store

examples.en: The plan was billed through the app store because that's where I started it.
examples.zh: 这项套餐「由应用商店计费」，因为我是在那里开通的。

examples.en: I checked whether our reading plan was billed through the app store.
examples.zh: 我确认了我们的阅读套餐是不是「由应用商店计费」。

collocations: a plan billed through the app store
a subscription billed through the app store
check whether it is billed through the app store

words.enDefinition: a status saying a subscription is set to end later

examples.en: The account displayed “Cancellation scheduled” next to the end date.
examples.zh: 账户在结束日期旁显示了「已安排取消订阅」。

examples.en: I saw “Cancellation scheduled” while the reading tools were still available.
examples.zh: 阅读工具仍可以用时，我看到了「已安排取消订阅」。

words.enDefinition: wording introducing when the new subscription option becomes active

examples.en: The note explained when the plan change takes effect for my reading app.
examples.zh: 说明写明了阅读应用的「套餐变更生效时间」。

examples.en: I checked the date when the plan change takes effect on my account.
examples.zh: 我查了账户里「套餐变更生效」的日期。

collocations: check when the plan change takes effect
a date when the plan change takes effect
see when your plan change takes effect

words.enDefinition: a feature for sharing eligible apps or services with a family group

examples.en: I checked whether family sharing included the drawing app before setting it up.
examples.zh: 设置之前，我查了「家庭共享」是否涵盖那个绘画应用。

examples.en: The instructions explained family sharing on a page separate from individual plans.
examples.zh: 说明在与个人套餐不同的页面上解释了「家庭共享」。

words.enDefinition: the account holder who manages a family sharing group

examples.en: My sister was the family organiser for our shared reading tools.
examples.zh: 我姐姐是我们共享阅读工具的「家庭组组织者」。

examples.en: The family organiser could see which apps were included in the group.
examples.zh: 「家庭组组织者」可以查看组里包含哪些应用。

words.enDefinition: the person whose account controls a particular subscription

examples.en: I checked who the subscription owner was before updating the reading plan.
examples.zh: 改阅读套餐前，我核实了谁是「订阅持有人」。

examples.en: The subscription owner was listed separately from the other people sharing access.
examples.zh: 「订阅持有人」与其他有共享权限的人分开列出。

words.enDefinition: a subscription option designed for one person to use

examples.en: I chose the individual plan because only I needed the drawing tools.
examples.zh: 我选了「个人套餐」，因为只有我需要这些绘画工具。

examples.en: The individual plan was shown beside the option for a family group.
examples.zh: 「个人套餐」显示在家庭组的选项旁边。

words.enDefinition: the maximum number of devices a licence or subscription covers

examples.en: I checked the device limit before adding the software to another tablet.
examples.zh: 把软件装到另一台平板之前，我查了「设备数量上限」。

examples.en: The terms listed a device limit for this version of the app.
examples.zh: 条款列出了这个应用版本的「设备数量上限」。

collocations: a device limit for a plan

words.enDefinition: whether a user meets the conditions for a trial

examples.en: I read the trial eligibility details before opening the offer page.
examples.zh: 打开优惠页面之前，我看了「试用资格」的详细说明。

examples.en: The account page showed my trial eligibility for the drawing programme.
examples.zh: 账户页面显示了我对绘画软件的「试用资格」。

words.enDefinition: to restore access to eligible purchases already associated with an app store account

examples.en: I used “Restore purchases” after opening the app on my new tablet.
examples.zh: 我在新平板上打开应用后，用了「恢复已购项目」。

examples.en: The account menu showed “Restore purchases” beneath the app's add-ons.
examples.zh: 账户菜单在应用附加功能的下方显示了「恢复已购项目」。

words.enDefinition: a status saying you previously bought the item on your account

examples.en: The listing said “Already purchased” when I opened the drawing pack.
examples.zh: 我打开绘画素材包时，详情页写着「已经购买」。

examples.en: I saw “Already purchased” above the button for opening the extra tools.
examples.zh: 我在打开额外工具的按钮上方看到了「已经购买」。

words.enDefinition: to move from a current subscription to a higher service level

examples.en: I checked what changed if I chose to upgrade a subscription that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午，我查看了选择「升级订阅套餐」会有哪些变化。

examples.en: The app showed where to upgrade a subscription from its account page.
examples.zh: 应用指明了在账户页面哪里可以「升级订阅套餐」。

collocations: an option to upgrade a subscription
check whether you can upgrade a subscription

words.enDefinition: a short summary of the service option and its main terms

examples.en: I opened the plan overview to check which drawing tools were included.
examples.zh: 我打开「套餐概览」，查看包含哪些绘画工具。

examples.en: The plan overview listed the access period beside the main features.
examples.zh: 「套餐概览」把可使用的期限和主要功能列在一起。

words.enDefinition: a status showing that another subscription period has started

examples.en: The account displayed “Subscription renewed” beside the name of my reading app.
examples.zh: 账户在阅读应用名称旁显示了「订阅已续订」。

examples.en: I saved the “Subscription renewed” message with my other account records.
examples.zh: 我把「订阅已续订」的消息和其他账户记录一起保存了。

words.enDefinition: to change to the level available without a subscription fee

examples.en: I decided to switch to the free tier after the group project ended.
examples.zh: 小组项目结束后，我决定「切换到免费档位」。

examples.en: The plan page explained how to switch to the free tier.
examples.zh: 套餐页面介绍了怎样「切换到免费档位」。

collocations: choose to switch to the free tier
plan to switch to the free tier
an option to switch to the free tier
